race.comment: Open race to close out the card. DIALIDAE (1) was too bad to be true here at the latest effort but the form prior was full of merit. Gets some well-needed weight relief with the 3kg claim and should be right there at the business end. DOUBTWILLY (4) will be ready to peak now third run back from a break and is another to get some weight off. Strong top-three prospects. TARA I AM (10) has placed two from two over this course and distance and doesn't know how to put in a poor one. Can run a race while fresh. BELVEDERE MISS (8) just ran into one better here last start and only needs some luck navigating from the sticky draw to play a major role in the finish. BLUE TOES (5) has some upside and shouldn't be underestimated.
